exposure: Maternal intrapartum vancomycin administration for group B streptococcus (GBS) prophylaxis
outcome: Vancomycin concentrations in umbilical cord blood
Cord blood vancomycin levels relative to GBS clinical minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) breakpoint
cohort: The study included a convenience sample of 26 neonates whose mothers received intrapartum weight-based vancomycin for GBS prophylaxis.
finding: Most neonates (92.3%) had vancomycin cord blood levels at or above the minimum inhibitory concentration breakpoint (1 microgram/mL) for GBS.
